program.section_heading: ART PHOTOGRAPHY, ASSOCIATE IN ARTS DEGREE
outcomes: Utilize various cameras, lenses, and photographic equipment to capture images that are both creatively and technically compelling in diverse lighting and environmental conditions.

Develop skills in both traditional darkroom processes and contemporary digital software to produce high-quality photographic prints, with an emphasis on controlling exposure, contrast, tonal range, and color.

Analyze and interpret photographic images with a critical eye, applying principles of visual literacy to discuss composition, meaning, and cultural context, while articulating informed critiques of their own work and the work of others.
Create a cohesive and professional portfolio that showcases technical expertise, creative vision, and conceptual depth, tailored to individual artistic goals or career aspirations.
Explore fine art photography as a medium for personal expression, developing the ability to conceptualize and execute projects that integrate aesthetic principles with meaningful narratives or ideas.
